# External sources

Directories recorded as Git submodules are pointers to reviewed upstream commits, not copies relicensed by this project. Initialize them with the documented script or a recursive Git clone. GitHub's download-ZIP feature does not include submodule contents.

`link-only/` contains placeholders for resources that are intentionally not cloned. Follow their links in [SOURCES.md](../SOURCES.md). Do not replace these placeholders with copied code or assets until the stated licensing issue has been resolved.
